page_topic_one_liner: SEO glossary reference — 240+ terms covering keyword research, technical SEO, link building, and on-page optimization
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a single-domain SEO term index / dictionary page, NOT the three-pillar glossary hub, NOT SEO content-strategy guide (no knowledge-graph moat or traffic curve), NOT a SERP tutorial or LLM chat. Hero must be an A–Z glossary index dense with SEO-specific term rows — NOT magnifying glass alone or generic dictionary app.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): SEO glossary index mockup — vertical A–Z alphabet sidebar (letter pills), main column with 6–8 stacked term rows (blurred SEO term titles like crawl budget, canonical, backlink + one-line definition blur), one row accent-highlighted
Secondary: dictionary page spread vignette — open reference spread with highlighted SEO term block and definition blur lines
Tertiary: floating term chip cloud (8–10 blurred SEO-domain chips: SERP, schema, sitemap, anchor text, DA, meta tags, etc.) clustered beside index
anti_patterns: Three-pillar hub cards (SEO/Marketing/AI) — this is SEO-only glossary
Knowledge-graph hub-spoke or evergreen traffic curve (that is seo/glossary strategy guide)
Google SERP results page as hero (that is serp tutorial, not glossary index)
Single term definition hero (one word + long paragraph)
Empty term rows, Ahrefs/Moz/SEMrush logos, or real brand names as readable text
